answer: A payout is split thus 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The opal schedule is applied in juniper and signal shows each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 979 identities would post 3088 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
